g.text: BankDash My Privileges VIP Suite Interaction & Animation Locators
Visual mapping of 7 luxury interactive zones: 3D metallic card, tier progression, reward vouchers & concierge
3D Parallax Tilt + Holographic Foil Shimmer
Prestige metallic card tilts with cursor coordinates; dynamic animated foil sheen & glowing badge
TRIGGER: Mouse movement over VIP member card
Interactive Tier Progression & Multiplier Bar
Live tier selector (Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Obsidian) with animated progress bar
TRIGGER: Clicking tier selector buttons
VIP Performance Metrics Count-Up & Glow
Points multiplier, tier cash-back, concierge status, and lounge passes with rolling numerical tickers
TRIGGER: Page load / Tier switch
Fluid Category Filter with Staggered Perks Fade
Filter benefits by All, Travel, Dining, Lifestyle, Wealth with staggered card entrance
TRIGGER: Clicking category tab pills
Perks Cards Elevation + Detail Modal Flow
Squircle icon hover zoom, tier exclusivity badge glow, and benefit activation modal
TRIGGER: Hovering perk cards / Clicking activate
Confetti Explosion + Live Points Redemption
Instant reward redemption with multi-colored particle confetti burst, toast alert,
and real-time points balance deduction ticker
TRIGGER: Clicking "Redeem Now" button on vouchers
Private Advisor Drawer & QR Pass Generator
Direct concierge call trigger and digital Apple Wallet pass modal with animated QR code
TRIGGER: Clicking Call Concierge or Generate Pass
KEY INTERACTIONS SUMMARY:
Card: 3D Foil Shimmer
Tier: Live Progression
Metrics: VIP Roll
Filter: Category Fade
Perks: Activation Modal
Vouchers: Confetti Burst
Concierge: QR Pass
All interactions use GPU hardware-accelerated transforms & zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0.00) with accessible aria controls.
